messages:
matt: Mid-window alert — we have a pipeline lock causing fallback to CPU pool and increased tail latency. There's a hotfix branch ready (v2.3.1-hotfix). Need expedited approvals to force the deploy and pin the version. Deploy bot shows a semaphore hold. Anyone from SRE/ops able to sign off?

deploy-bot: CI job #9876 status: blocked (pipeline semaphore: release/2026-03-20-lock). Current queue: 3. To force: `deploy-bot force-deploy --ticket=<link>` (requires 3 approvers).

anya: what's the risk if we skip canary entirely? can we do a fast ramp instead? :thinking_face:

sre_eli: skipping full canary is risky given CPU fallback, but we can do an expedited ramp: 25% for 5m, check p50/p95 and 5xx, then 100% if green. Rollback criteria: immediate revert to v2.3.0 if any of the following in first 10m after ramp: >1% 5xx OR p95 > 700ms OR error spike >= +300% baseline.

jade: I can approve from product side for the release note and customer comms. :white_check_mark:

ops-oncall: I can approve operationally if we keep the fast ramp and a 15-min watch with SRE on pager. Also want a kill-switch runbook link in the thread.

cleo: add a feature-flag rollback hook so we can flip traffic immediately if needed. I can push the flag change if SRE gives the go.

matt: tagging approvals: matt (me), anya, sre_eli, ops-oncall, jade. Need three explicit approvers per deploy-bot. I'll paste the force-deploy command I'm about to run: ```
# force deploy command
deploy-bot force-deploy --env=prod --tag=v2.3.1-hotfix --ramp=25%:5m,100%:after --reason="mid-window hotfix: pipeline lock fallback" --approvals=matt,anya,sre_eli,ops-oncall
```

anya: approved 

sre_eli: approved — will watch metrics and be ready to rollback.

ops-oncall: approved. monitoring + alert overrides set.

deploy-bot: Approval count: 4/3. Lock override accepted. Initiating deploy: creating release artifact, pinning tag v2.3.1-hotfix. Starting staged rollout.

deploy-bot: Rollout started: 25% traffic -> env=prod -> tag=v2.3.1-hotfix. Expected ramp duration: 5m. Notifying observability channels.

matt: Adding release note draft to the release tracker: "v2.3.1-hotfix — mid-window patch to address pipeline semaphore fallback causing CPU servicing; pinned runtime ttls and KVCACHE fix." Will follow up with changelog link shortly.

cleo: feature-flag ready, will flip if SRE says. :muscle:

sre_eli: seeing initial metrics — p50 stable, p95 +40ms, 5xx = 0. No action yet. Continuing watch.

matt: thanks team. If anything degrades, recall plan: immediate tag rollback + traffic pin to v2.3.0 and open a postmortem.

deploy-bot: Update: 25% ramp complete, metrics within thresholds. Proceeding to 100% now. Deployment finished. :rocket:

jade: nice. please drop the quick blurb to customers in #customer-notice when we have 100% done.

matt: will do. filing post-deploy note and linking monitoring graphs. :thumbsup:
